title: Optimize the Harness, Not the Model: Fitting a Minimal Agent to a Self-Hostable LLM for Investigative Analysis
title_zh: 优化执行框架而非模型：为可自托管的LLM匹配极简智能体以开展调查分析

paragraphs.en: Government intelligence teams need LLM agents that can analyze large, messy evidence collections, but security and cost constraints often rule out hosted frontier models and broad, hard-to-audit tool surfaces. We report CLEO : C onstrained L oop for E nvironment O ptimization, a method for fitting a minimal agent harness to a fixed, self-hostable LLM. Given an expert-validated dataset, CLEO admits only the tools, guardrails, memory policies, and loop components that improve accuracy while remaining general and auditable. On our held-out dataset, the CLEO harness reaches an 83.8 83.8 % pass rate, within 1.2 1.2 points of the strongest out-of-the-box Claude Code SDK baseline, while being two orders of magnitude smaller.
paragraphs.zh: 政府情报团队需要能够分析大量杂乱证据集合的大语言模型智能体，但安全与成本方面的限制往往排除了托管的前沿模型，以及广泛而难以审计的工具接口。 我们提出 CLEO：即面向环境优化的受限循环（Constrained Loop for Environment Optimization），这是一种为固定的、可自托管的大语言模型拟合最小化智能体框架的方法。 给定一个经过专家验证的数据集，CLEO 只保留那些能提升准确率、同时保持通用性和可审计性的工具、防护机制、记忆策略和循环组件。 在我们的留出数据集上，CLEO 框架达到了 83.8 83.8 % 的通过率，与最强的开箱即用 Claude Code SDK 基线仅相差 1.2 1.2 个百分点，而其规模小了两个数量级。

paragraphs.en: Analysts in government organizations investigate complex cases spanning thousands of heterogeneous documents—emails, reports, call records, spreadsheets, chat logs, and multilingual material with inconsistent or unknown schemas—revisiting them repeatedly to aggregate evidence, reconcile contradictions, trace entities, and build coherent explanations.
paragraphs.zh: 政府机构的分析师需要调查跨越数千份异构文档的复杂案件——电子邮件、报告、通话记录、电子表格、聊天记录，以及模式不一致或未知的多种语言材料——并反复查阅这些文档，以汇总证据、化解矛盾、追踪实体并构建连贯的解释。

paragraphs.en: LLM agents can make such investigations tractable, but only through a harness : the tools, memory, execution policies, and control loop that let the model search corpora, inspect files, run analyses, and refine hypotheses. In high-security settings both the served model and the harness are constrained: data sensitivity and cost push organizations toward smaller self-hostable models, while security review forces tight control over exposed capabilities—every new tool and every line of harness code must be inspected, justified, and often certified before deployment.
paragraphs.zh: 大语言模型智能体（LLM agents）能够使这类研究变得切实可行，但前提是必须借助一个执行框架（harness）：即让模型能够检索语料、检查文件、运行分析并完善假设的工具、记忆、执行策略与控制循环。 在高安全等级的环境中，所部署的模型和执行框架都会受到限制：数据敏感性和成本促使组织倾向于使用更小的可自托管模型，而安全审查则要求对暴露的能力进行严格控制——每一个新工具和每一行执行框架代码在部署前都必须经过检查、论证，且往往需要获得认证。

paragraphs.en: Two lines of work bear on this. Harness design spans reason-and-act control ( 1 ) , filesystem agent–computer interfaces ( 2 ) , lean and generic-purpose harness implementations such as PI ( 7 ) . Harness optimization automates this design, from agent-design search ( 3 ) to autoresearch-like loops ( 4 ) and observability-driven harness evolution ( 10 ) . Evidence access is a further design choice: where the dominant pattern pre-indexes the corpus into embeddings ( 8 ) , indexless access through raw-file search and scripts can match or beat strong retrievers on evolving, heterogeneous corpora ( 9 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 有两条工作线与此相关。 框架设计涵盖「推理与行动」控制 ( 1 )、文件系统类智能体–计算机接口 ( 2 )，以及 PI ( 7 ) 等精简且通用的框架实现。 框架优化将这一设计自动化，从智能体设计搜索 ( 3 ) 到类 autoresearch 的循环 ( 4 )，再到可观测性驱动的框架演化 ( 10 )。 证据访问是另一项设计选择：主流做法是将语料库预索引为嵌入向量 ( 8 )，而通过原始文件搜索和脚本实现的无索引访问，在不断演化、异构的语料库上可以媲美甚至超越强大的检索器 ( 9 )。

paragraphs.en: We report CLEO , a method that enabled us to launch a deployed investigative agent around a fixed, self-hostable model and a deliberately minimal harness. We use CLEO for both the optimization method and the resulting production harness. CLEO’s first contribution is an explicit justification gate : proposed harness changes must improve accuracy and also be generic, auditable, and worth the added capability surface. This realizes the multi-objective harness that was mentioned but not studied in ( 3 ) . Its second contribution is bottom-up harness construction : the harness starts nearly empty and grows only when evaluation shows that a new tool, guardrail, memory policy, or loop component is necessary. Minimality is therefore optimized by construction, not patched in later. The resulting agent holds up on held-out, out-of-distribution cases (Table 1 ), is small enough for security review, and is currently being deployed in client environments.
paragraphs.zh: 我们报告 CLEO，这一方法使我们能够在固定的、可自托管的模型和一个刻意保持极简的框架之上，部署一个实际投入运行的调查型智能体。 我们将 CLEO 同时用作优化方法的名称和由此产生的生产框架的名称。 CLEO 的第一个贡献是显式的正当性门控： proposed 的框架变更不仅必须提升准确率，还必须是通用的、可审计的，并且值得引入额外的能力面。 这实现了 (3) 中被提及但未被研究的多目标框架。 其第二个贡献是自底向上的框架构建：框架以近乎空置的状态起步，只有当评估表明需要新的工具、防护栏、记忆策略或循环组件时才会增长。 因此，极简性是通过构建方式被优化的，而不是事后修补的。 由此得到的智能体在保留集和分布外案例上表现稳健（表 1），规模小到足以进行安全审查，目前正在客户环境中部署。

paragraphs.en: Datasets. Intelligence analysts work across distinct use cases , each a self-contained investigation with its own documents and questions; the product must serve many, so we build and evaluate on three. Within a use case, files are grouped into corpora —ingestion, classification, investigation, insights, reporting, and multilingual content—that overlap in their documents but differ in which files are relevant to a given query. A representative use case holds about 8,000 files across up to seven formats, with corpora from roughly 250 MB to 6 GB, and includes misleading and contradictory evidence to stress robustness. Across the three use cases we author 300+ expert questions at four difficulty levels; 240 are held out for evaluation and the rest form the optimization pool.
paragraphs.zh: 数据集。 情报分析师的工作跨越多个不同的使用场景，每个场景都是一项自成一体的调查，拥有各自的文档和问题；产品必须服务于众多场景，因此我们在三个场景上进行构建和评估。 在一个使用场景内，文件被分组为多个语料库——摄取、分类、调查、洞察、报告和多语言内容——这些语料库在文档上有所重叠，但区别在于哪些文件与给定查询相关。 一个具有代表性的使用场景包含约 8,000 个文件，涵盖多达七种格式，语料库规模从约 250 MB 到 6 GB 不等，并包含误导性和相互矛盾的证据以检验鲁棒性。 在三个使用场景中，我们编写了 300 多个专家问题，分为四个难度级别；其中 240 个留作评估之用，其余构成优化池。

paragraphs.en: The model. We work with self-hostable (on-premises), open-weights LLMs and treat the model as fixed : the method optimizes everything around it. We report results with GLM-5.1 ( 5 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 该模型。 我们使用可自托管（本地部署）的开源权重 LLM，并将模型视为固定不变：该方法优化模型周围的一切。 我们报告了使用 GLM-5.1 ( 5 ) 的结果。

paragraphs.en: Optimization-loop dataset. The optimization loop runs on a single use case of four corpora, approximately 3,000 files in total. Each iteration evaluates the harness on 44 Q&A pairs: a fixed core of 32—eight per corpus, drawn from all difficulty levels—plus 12 sampled fresh from the development pool every iteration. We keep the evaluation set small so each optimization iteration finishes within minutes, staying inside our time and compute budget. Periodically the pool is swapped for an out-of-distribution development case. The final 240-question benchmark in Table 1 is held out and never exposed to the supervisor loop.
paragraphs.zh: 优化循环数据集。 优化循环在单一用例上运行，该用例包含四个语料库，总计约 3,000 个文件。 每次迭代在 44 个问答对上评估测试框架：固定的 32 个核心问答对——每个语料库八个，覆盖所有难度级别——加上每次迭代从开发池中全新抽取的 12 个问答对。 我们保持评估集规模较小，以便每次优化迭代在几分钟内完成，符合我们的时间和算力预算。 该池会定期被换成一个分布外开发用例。 表 1 中最终的 240 题基准测试是保留集，从不暴露给监督者循环。

paragraphs.en: A minimal harness. The initial agent is a ReAct-style model-in-a-loop ( 1 ) with a short list of terminal tools— ls , read , grep , a sandboxed non-persistent Python—and nothing else. CLEO builds on this minimal, file-system-native toolset, adding only the persistent per-case memory an analyst workflow needs.
paragraphs.zh: 一个最小化的运行框架。 初始的智能体是一个 ReAct 风格的“循环中的模型”（ 1 ），配备一份简短的终结型工具列表—— ls 、 read 、 grep 、一个沙箱化的非持久 Python——此外别无其他。 CLEO 在这套极简的、原生于文件系统的工具集之上构建，仅添加分析师工作流所需的按案例持久化记忆。

sents.en: CLEO builds on this minimal, file-system-native toolset, adding only the persistent per-case memory an analyst workflow needs.
sents.zh: CLEO 在这套极简的、原生于文件系统的工具集之上构建，仅添加分析师工作流所需的按案例持久化记忆。

paragraphs.en: Inspired by autoresearch ( 4 ) , a supervisor model (a frontier LLM - we chose Opus-4.8 ( 12 ) ) drives an automatic propose–test–keep loop over harness versions (Algorithm 1 ). A proposed change is kept only if it improves the current evaluation objective a a —the pass-rate/soft-score summary produced by Eval —by a margin ϵ \epsilon on the current graded subset D t D_{t} and survives our key contribution: a justification check that asks whether the edit is generic, auditable, and as lean as possible. This second gate is meant to guard against both benchmark overfitting and scaffold bloat. Accepted changes define the final harness: a small set of tools plus tuned guardrails, retry/refusal handling, context compaction, memory policy, and tool-call budgets. They trigger an error analysis that drives the next proposal. To prevent the loop from fitting a single case, the evaluation set is periodically swapped for an out-of-distribution pool. Eval runs the candidate on 32 fixed and 12 randomly drawn Q&A and scores each cited answer with an LLM judge ( 6 ) against expert ground truth. We optimize bottom-up rather than pruning a large off-the-shelf harness: in a broad harness much must be removed, and deciding which capabilities are unnecessary is itself a slow security and engineering exercise. In our experiments, top-down optimization matched bottom-up on accuracy but barely shrank the harness, whereas the near-empty CLEO loop added only what it needed—e.g., read/write memory tools and a non-answer safety net with a retry loop. Conversely, a cite() helper, proposed after error analysis showed the judge penalizing answers with missing evidence, was reverted: the agent rarely used it, so the change failed the justification gate.
paragraphs.zh: 受 autoresearch（4）启发，一个监督模型（前沿大语言模型——我们选择了 Opus-4.8（12））驱动一个针对 harness 版本的自动「提议—测试—保留」循环（算法 1）。 一个提议的修改只有在它比当前评估目标高出边际 ϵ \epsilon（即由 Eval 产生的通过率/软分数汇总），且作用在当前已评分子集 D t D_{t} 上有提升，并通过我们的关键贡献——一个审查该修改是否通用、可审计且尽可能精简的正当性检查——时才会被保留。 这第二道关口旨在防范基准过拟合与脚手架膨胀。 被接受的修改定义了最终的 harness：一小组工具加上调优过的防护栏、重试/拒绝处理、上下文压缩、记忆策略以及工具调用预算。 它们会触发一次错误分析，进而驱动下一个提议。 为防止该循环拟合单一案例，评估集会定期换成一个分布外样本池。 Eval 在 32 个固定和 12 个随机抽取的问答上运行候选版本，并用一个 LLM 裁判（6）对照专家标准答案为每个带引用的答案打分。 我们采用自底向上的优化，而不是修剪一个庞大的现成 harness：在庞大的 harness 中必须删掉很多东西，而判断哪些能力是不必要的本身就是一项缓慢的安全与工程工作。 在我们的实验中，自顶向下的优化在准确率上与自底向上持平，但几乎未能缩减 harness，而近乎空白的 CLEO 循环只添加了它所需要的东西——例如读写记忆工具，以及一个带重试循环的非答案安全网。 相反，一个 cite() 辅助函数在错误分析显示裁判会惩罚缺少证据的答案后被提出，但又被回退：智能体很少使用它，因此该修改未能通过正当性关口。

sents.en: Inspired by autoresearch ( 4 ) , a supervisor model (a frontier LLM - we chose Opus-4.8 ( 12 ) ) drives an automatic propose–test–keep loop over harness versions (Algorithm 1 ).
sents.zh: 受 autoresearch（4）启发，一个监督模型（前沿大语言模型——我们选择了 Opus-4.8（12））驱动一个针对 harness 版本的自动「提议—测试—保留」循环（算法 1）。

sents.en: A proposed change is kept only if it improves the current evaluation objective a a —the pass-rate/soft-score summary produced by Eval —by a margin ϵ \epsilon on the current graded subset D t D_{t} and survives our key contribution: a justification check that asks whether the edit is generic, auditable, and as lean as possible.
sents.zh: 一个提议的修改只有在它比当前评估目标高出边际 ϵ \epsilon（即由 Eval 产生的通过率/软分数汇总），且作用在当前已评分子集 D t D_{t} 上有提升，并通过我们的关键贡献——一个审查该修改是否通用、可审计且尽可能精简的正当性检查——时才会被保留。

sents.en: This second gate is meant to guard against both benchmark overfitting and scaffold bloat.
sents.zh: 这第二道关口旨在防范基准过拟合与脚手架膨胀。

sents.en: Accepted changes define the final harness: a small set of tools plus tuned guardrails, retry/refusal handling, context compaction, memory policy, and tool-call budgets.
sents.zh: 被接受的修改定义了最终的 harness：一小组工具加上调优过的防护栏、重试/拒绝处理、上下文压缩、记忆策略以及工具调用预算。

sents.en: They trigger an error analysis that drives the next proposal.
sents.zh: 它们会触发一次错误分析，进而驱动下一个提议。

sents.en: To prevent the loop from fitting a single case, the evaluation set is periodically swapped for an out-of-distribution pool.
sents.zh: 为防止该循环拟合单一案例，评估集会定期换成一个分布外样本池。

sents.en: Eval runs the candidate on 32 fixed and 12 randomly drawn Q&A and scores each cited answer with an LLM judge ( 6 ) against expert ground truth.
sents.zh: Eval 在 32 个固定和 12 个随机抽取的问答上运行候选版本，并用一个 LLM 裁判（6）对照专家标准答案为每个带引用的答案打分。

sents.en: We optimize bottom-up rather than pruning a large off-the-shelf harness: in a broad harness much must be removed, and deciding which capabilities are unnecessary is itself a slow security and engineering exercise.
sents.zh: 我们采用自底向上的优化，而不是修剪一个庞大的现成 harness：在庞大的 harness 中必须删掉很多东西，而判断哪些能力是不必要的本身就是一项缓慢的安全与工程工作。

sents.en: Conversely, a cite() helper, proposed after error analysis showed the judge penalizing answers with missing evidence, was reverted: the agent rarely used it, so the change failed the justification gate.
sents.zh: 相反，一个 cite() 辅助函数在错误分析显示裁判会惩罚缺少证据的答案后被提出，但又被回退：智能体很少使用它，因此该修改未能通过正当性关口。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate four agent harnesses on our intelligence analysis benchmarks, holding fixed the model (GLM-5.1 ( 5 ) ), and a single Claude Opus 4.8 LLM judge ( 12 , 6 ) . The judge receives the candidate answer and expert ground truth, then returns a correct/incorrect verdict and a 0–10 soft score.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在情报分析基准上评估了四个智能体框架，保持模型（GLM-5.1（5））和单个 Claude Opus 4.8 LLM 评审（12，6）固定不变。 评审接收候选答案和专家标准答案，然后给出正确/错误的判定以及一个 0–10 的软评分。

sents.en: We evaluate four agent harnesses on our intelligence analysis benchmarks, holding fixed the model (GLM-5.1 ( 5 ) ), and a single Claude Opus 4.8 LLM judge ( 12 , 6 ) .
sents.zh: 我们在情报分析基准上评估了四个智能体框架，保持模型（GLM-5.1（5））和单个 Claude Opus 4.8 LLM 评审（12，6）固定不变。

sents.zh: 评审接收候选答案和专家标准答案，然后给出正确/错误的判定以及一个 0–10 的软评分。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate three baselines spanning two design axes: harness size (a large off-the-shelf harness vs. a lightweight one) and prompt (generic vs. CLEO-optimized), reporting accuracy, latency, and estimated harness size for each. The large harness is the Claude Code SDK ( 11 ) , a mature production-grade system we treat as a reference point for what a general-purpose harness achieves out of the box, paired with a generic task-context prompt generated by Claude itself. The lightweight harness is PI ( 7 ) , a minimal execution loop with no domain-specific prompting—the natural comparison for CLEO, though still considerably larger. PI #1 receives the same prompt as Claude; PI #2 receives CLEO’s full optimized prompt.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在两个设计维度上评估三个基线：框架大小（大型现成框架 vs. 轻量级框架）以及提示词（通用提示词 vs. CLEO 优化提示词），并报告每个配置的准确率、延迟和估计的框架大小。 大型框架是 Claude Code SDK（11），一个成熟的生产级系统，我们将其作为通用框架开箱即用所能达到水平的参考点，并搭配由 Claude 自身生成的通用任务上下文提示词。 轻量级框架是 PI（7），一个没有领域特定提示词的最小执行循环——它是与 CLEO 进行比较的自然对象，尽管其规模仍然大得多。 PI #1 使用与 Claude 相同的提示词；PI #2 使用 CLEO 的完整优化提示词。

paragraphs.en: Table 1 shows that CLEO, despite its tiny harness, is competitive with the substantially larger Claude Code SDK: an 83.8% pass rate and 8.41/10 soft score, within 1.2 percentage points and 0.07 soft-score points of the best baseline. On 240 held-out questions that gap is roughly three questions, so we read this as practical parity rather than a ranking. CLEO also matches or outperforms both PI versions on pass rate with a much smaller harness surface and similar latency. Given the small accuracy gap against the large LOC gap, CLEO is the best trade-off. The bottom-up direction matters: we ran a top-down loop from PI, permitting all modifications and encouraging removals, yet it matched bottom-up on accuracy while barely shrinking the harness.
paragraphs.zh: 表1显示，尽管CLEO的测试框架极小，但其与规模大得多的Claude Code SDK相比仍具竞争力：通过率为83.8%，软性得分为8.41/10，与最佳基线的差距在1.2个百分点和0.07软性得分以内。 在240道保留题上，这一差距大约相当于三道题，因此我们将其视为实践上的持平，而非排名上的差异。 CLEO在通过率上还以小得多的框架规模和相近的延迟，达到甚至超越了两个PI版本。 鉴于准确率差距小而代码行数差距大，CLEO是最佳的折中选择。 自底向上的方向很重要：我们以PI为起点运行了一个自顶向下的循环，允许所有修改并鼓励删减，但它在准确率上仅与自底向上持平，而框架几乎没有缩小。

paragraphs.en: This work shows that ground-up harness optimization is a practical direction for deploying agentic systems in regulated domains: a minimal harness approaches the accuracy of the strongest out-of-the-box harness with two orders of magnitude less code and capability surface. The result holds within a defined scope: a base model already capable of multi-step tool use, one investigative domain, and accuracy scored by an LLM judge that domain experts and product managers spot-checked but that we did not validate systematically. Within those limits, careful harness design is an effective systems optimization: exposing only task-essential capabilities retains competitive performance while improving maintainability, auditability, and operational simplicity for production deployments.
paragraphs.zh: 这项工作表明，从零开始进行 harness 优化是在受监管领域部署智能体系统的一个可行方向：一个极简的 harness 能以少两个数量级的代码量和能力面，接近最强的开箱即用 harness 的准确率。 该结论在特定范围内成立：基座模型已具备多步骤工具使用能力，仅限一个调查领域，且准确率由 LLM 评审打分，领域专家和产品经理进行了抽查，但我们并未对其进行系统性验证。 在这些限制之内，精心的 harness 设计是一种有效的系统优化：仅暴露任务必需的能力，既能保持有竞争力的性能，又能提升生产部署的可维护性、可审计性和运维简单性。
